# 2.3 Geospatial data {.unnumbered}

## Story problem

**Why your Auckland map looks shifted**

- You plot the boundaries and something is off.
- The issue is almost always CRS.
- You learn to check CRS first and transform deliberately.

## What you will learn

- Read/write GeoPackage and GeoJSON.
- CRS basics and transformations.
- Make a quick static map for sanity checking.

## GeoPandas essentials

- Geometry column
- CRS and `to_crs()`
- Plotting for quick checks
